Picture a welcome circle where everyone picks one thing to listen for, pauses the group chooses together, and a closing share where each person names one observation. These moments are proposed, fictional ideas; only the cited claims are route facts.

Imagine a welcome chat about what drew each rider in, stops the group agrees on together, and a relaxed debrief where everyone names a favourite moment. The ride plan is a fictional concept; only the cited claims are route facts.
